title: Defi Pirates
tagline: Defi Pirates is real-time GameFi chest hunting extraction duel
description: Each game 2 players firstly stake their wager in Yellow state channel then they get dropped on an island where they have to compete searching for a hidden chest. During gameplay users can collect resources to boost their walking speed, digging efficiency or try to craft a map to get directions for area with hidden chest.
how_its_made: All the gameplay is orchestrated by game server and routed through Yellow state channels for in-game wagers, resource collection and all the other in-game state from movement to choosing winner. Frontend connects to the server indirectly, not through API calls but using session with Yellow clear node.
